content: The trailing clouds of glory are never completely dispersed from our consciousness.
author: William James
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Across his life and work, William James saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
